Ryan Dominguez and Taylor Medical Group

Dear Colleague,

I recently had the opportunity to consult with Mr. Randy Hendricks on November 20, 2024. This consultation was prompted by a report of back strain. During our visit, we conducted a thorough review of his medical history and current health status.

Mr. Hendricks has been managing several chronic conditions for which I am providing an update. 

Firstly, concerning his Rheumatoid arthritis, which he has been dealing with since February 2011, I am pleased to report that it remains well-controlled. He is currently not on any medications for this condition, but rather managed through regular monitoring and lifestyle adjustments.

Regarding his Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, diagnosed in May 2020, the treatment was completed approximately 4.3 years ago. His condition is under control with no need for ongoing medication. This aggressive type of NHL has not shown any signs of recurrence thus far.

Mr. Hendricks also suffers from eczema, which began in September 2022. He is currently managing this with tacrolimus topical 0.1%, which has proven effective in controlling his symptoms.

Additionally, he has been dealing with erectile dysfunction since September 2020. This is being managed with tadalafil 20 mg, which he finds satisfactory in terms of efficacy.

Lastly, Mr. Hendricks has a history of vitamin D deficiency, first noted in February 2015. He has been on ergocalciferol 50000 IU, and his levels have been adequately maintained.

During our consultation, we also reviewed his vital signs. His blood pressure was recorded at 125/68 mmHg, and his weight was 153 pounds. His physical exam was otherwise within normal limits aside from the back strain he reported. We also discussed his social habits, noting that he is a current smoker of cigarettes, smoking approximately 5 per day, and consumes about 12 alcoholic drinks per week.

In summary, all of Mr. Hendricks' chronic conditions are well-controlled with no need for changes in his current management plans. He is compliant with his medications and follows up regularly.

Thank you for referring Mr. Hendricks to me. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you need any further information.

Sincerely,

Dr. Lisa Miller
Family Medicine
Ryan Dominguez and Taylor Medical Group
